lead.title: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash, a natively multimodal open-weights model
lead.summary: DeepSeek shipped V4.1-Flash with open weights on September 10 — a natively multimodal (vision and language) model built on a 552B sparse backbone with roughly 8B–16B active parameters. It supports up to 1M context, a shared compressed KV cache, a two-stage sparse indexer, and a 196B Engram lookup memory, with SGLang adding day-0 inference and reinforcement-learning support.

top_stories.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for financial services powered by GPT-6 Astra
top_stories.summary: OpenAI unveiled a tailored enterprise ChatGPT for financial services, bundling premium datasets (Daloopa, PitchBook, LSEG News) with GPT-6 Astra reasoning for research, model building, and templated client materials with evidence tracing.

top_stories.title: Anthropic publishes its most detailed Claude threat-intelligence report
top_stories.summary: Anthropic detailed real-world misuse of Claude spanning cyber operations, influence campaigns, surveillance, and weapons development, and said it disrupted every highlighted operation and shared its findings with law enforcement.

top_stories.title: Huawei lifts suggested price of Ascend 950DT accelerator ~60% to ~250,000 yuan
top_stories.summary: Huawei raised the suggested price of its Ascend 950DT AI accelerator about 60% over three months to roughly 250,000 yuan (~$37,300) per card, as demand outruns supply amid the data-center boom and a high-bandwidth-memory shortage.

top_stories.title: ABF substrate supply crunch looms beneath every AI accelerator
top_stories.summary: Tom's Hardware details the ABF substrate bottleneck constraining data-center silicon, noting Ajinomoto's film capacity running at full load (~2M square meters a month) in Q2 2026, with expansion planned but still tight.

items.title: GPU-CFR: 80x faster counterfactual regret minimization by compiling the game to static dataflow and CUDA graph replay
items.summary: Compiles CFR game-tree sweeps into static dataflow graphs with CUDA graph replay, delivering an 80x speedup over prior GPU implementations and, for the first time, making CFR run faster on GPUs than CPUs.

items.title: SenseNova-U1.5: towards native unified visual intelligence
items.summary: An 8B mixture-of-transformer multimodal model that understands, reasons about, and generates visual content in an encoder-free, VAE-free architecture, supporting native resolutions up to 4K via spatially coherent patch reconstruction.

items.title: RetroThinker: enabling retrospective thinking in speech LLMs
items.summary: Introduces a retrospective-thinking mechanism for speech-LLMs that recovers reasoning quality on complex tasks without the latency cost of full chain-of-thought, narrowing the reasoning gap to text-only models under real-time constraints.

items.title: MindTopo: can foundation models reason in topological space?
items.summary: A benchmark evaluating topological (deformation-invariant) spatial reasoning across foundation models, showing they lean on metric and viewpoint-dependent relations and exposing systematic gaps in topological intuition.

items.title: CausalArena: benchmarking causal discovery in the foundation model era
items.summary: A standardized benchmark of structural causal models and evaluation protocols for causal discovery, targeting the emerging use of foundation models to uncover causal structure from data.

items.title: AuK, an open-source foundation model for speech generation and editing
items.summary: A newly released open-weights model handling both text-to-speech generation and audio editing in one framework, trained on about 3 billion instance pairs with preference optimization, with weights and code released.

items.title: Together AI pushes Thunderkittens kernels to new highs on NVIDIA Rubin
items.summary: Together AI shared open-source Thunderkittens kernel work reaching high performance on NVIDIA's new Rubin architecture — an inference-efficiency contribution rather than a new model release.

items.title: Nous Research shows live sub-agent visibility and steering in Hermes Agent
items.summary: Nous Research showed an updated Hermes Agent with detailed live activity on all sub-agents and the ability to steer or stop individual agents from both the CLI and a desktop app.

items.title: Skild AI taps NVIDIA physical AI stack to teach robots via S1 model
items.summary: NVIDIA detailed how Skild AI built its S1 physical-AI model on NVIDIA infrastructure, spanning synthetic data generation, model training, simulation, and real-world robot deployment.

items.title: Humanoid robot reportedly outruns fastest human at China's World Humanoid Robotic Games
items.summary: At China's World Humanoid Robotic Games, a humanoid robot reportedly outpaced the fastest human in history, a showcase meant to gauge how quickly robots are improving toward real-world work.

items.title: China's humanoid robot boom, part III: when is the ChatGPT moment?
items.summary: TechNode examines China's humanoid robot shipment share for the first half of 2026 using Counterpoint research, exploring when the sector might reach its 'ChatGPT moment' amid surging investment.

items.title: Swarmer to acquire Ukrainian UGV maker Ratel Robotics for up to $224M
items.summary: Swarmer agreed to acquire Ukrainian uncrewed ground vehicle maker Ratel Robotics in a deal worth up to $224 million, expanding its autonomous systems lineup.

items.title: Desert Ant Labs: local, fast AI models that run entirely on device
items.summary: Local, fast AI models that run entirely on device, targeting edge and privacy-preserving inference without cloud connectivity.

items.title: Switch brings any AI agent into Slack, Teams and Discord
items.summary: Brings any AI agent into Slack, Teams, and Discord chat, letting teams invoke agents directly inside their existing messaging workflows.

items.title: Widgo: an AI sales rep that engages website visitors autonomously
items.summary: An AI sales rep that engages your website visitors autonomously, qualifying leads and responding in real time.

items.title: Catenary: a spatial canvas IDE for AI coding agents
items.summary: A spatial canvas IDE designed for AI coding agents, giving a visual workspace for multi-agent development.

items.title: Replay QA Security Scan: automated pentesting for AI-built apps
items.summary: Automated penetration testing specifically for AI-built apps, surfacing security issues before shipment.

items.title: Arlequin AI lands EUR 28M Series A to scale topological neural network technology
items.summary: EUR 28M Series A (~$32M) for the Paris-based topological neural network developer, co-led by redalpine and OTB Ventures with Bpifrance Defence Innovation Fund, Vsquared, 10x Founders and Xavier Niel.

items.title: Inspiren raises $70M Series C to bring AI into senior-living operations
items.summary: $70M Series C at a $550M valuation, led by NewView Capital with Insight Partners, Primary, Scale, Vintage, Lightbank, Avenir and Camber Creek.

items.title: Rogo Technologies secures ~$30M strategic financing from global banks
items.summary: Roughly $30M in new strategic investment from Citi, Barclays, BNP Paribas, MUFG and Societe Generale, following a $160M Series D at about a $2B valuation.

items.title: Graph AI raises $13.3M to automate pharmaceutical safety operations
items.summary: $13.3M round led by Insight Partners with Bessemer Venture Partners; the Graph Safety platform automates pharmacovigilance.

items.title: Metacognition AI raises A$10M pre-seed for persistent-memory AI layer
items.summary: A$10M pre-seed from Main Sequence (CSIRO-backed) for a persistent-memory, reasoning and control layer beneath frontier models — a record Australian pre-seed.
